name: Conquer Novgorod
goal: Own or Vassalize 4+ Provinces in NOVGOROD, KARELIA, or POMORYE.
effect: Gain a Claim token in an Area adjacent to your Realm, and 2 Influence cubes in MOSCOW & RYAZAN, CENTRAL RUSSIA, or PERM.

name: Liberate Ruthenia
goal: Own or Vassalize any 4+ Provinces in WHITE RUTHENIA, WESTERN UKRAINE, or EASTERN UKRAINE.
effect: Gain 2 Claim tokens or 4 Influence cubes in Areas adjacent to your Realm.

name: Control the Volga
goal: Own or Vassalize Provinces with a total Tax Value of 6 among Kazan, Volga, or any Provinces in SARATOV or ASTRAKHAN.
effect: Gain a Claim token in CRIMEA, Nogai, or Tyumen.

name: The Siberian Frontier
goal: Own Ural and West Siberia.
effect: Gain a Claim token in East Siberia.

name: Form Russia
goal: Own all Provinces in MOSCOW & RYAZAN, CENTRAL RUSSIA, VOLOGDA, PERM, NOVGOROD, KARELIA, and POMORYE. Have at least +1 Stability.
effect: Gain Influence cubes in 3 of these Areas, and a Claim token in SARATOV or WHITE RUTHENIA.

name: Black Sea Ports
goal: Own or Vassalize 5+ Ports facing the BLACK SEA.
effect: Gain 2 Light Ships in the BLACK SEA.

name: Consolidate the Steppes
goal: Own 2+ of Tyumen, Nogai, and Kazakhstan.
effect: Gain 3 Military Power and a Claim token adjacent to one of those Areas.

name: Reach the Pacific Ocean
goal: Own East Siberia and Okhotsk.
effect: Gain 1 Light Ship in the SEA OF OKHOTSK, and either 2 Trade Power in Furdan or a Claim token.

name: Window on the West
goal: Own or Vassalize 5+ Ports facing the BALTIC SEA or GULF OF BOTHNIA.
effect: Develop a Small Town adjacent to the BALTIC SEA or GULF OF BOTHNIA into a Large Town; gain 2 Trade Power.

name: City of the World?s Desire
goal: Own or Vassalize Constantinople, and at least one of Athina, Morea, or Naxos.
effect: Gain Imperial Authority in MACEDONIA & THRACE and a Claim token in SERBIA & ALBANIA. You may pay 2 Diplomatic Power to immediately Research the ?Tolerance? Idea.

name: Expand Devshirme System
goal: Have all your Active Ally tokens Deployed.
effect: Gain a Claim token in NORTHERN ANATOLIA and KARAMAN. You may pay 2 Military Power to immediately Research the ?Tercios/Janissaries? Idea.

name: Last Crusader Bastion
goal: Annex or Vassalize Rhodes during Peace Resolution.
effect: Gain 1 Galley, and a Claim token in AEGEAN ARCHIPELAGO or CYPRUS.

name: Balkan Foothold
goal: Own or Vassalize 5+ Provinces in SERBIA & ALBANIA, CROATIA & BOSNIA, or WALLACHIA & BULGARIA.
effect: Gain a Claim token in 3 of DALMATIA, HUNGARIAN PLAIN, TRANSYLVANIA, or any of the Areas above.

name: Safeguard Anatolia
goal: Own or Vassalize 5+ Provinces in KARAMAN, or in Areas adjacent to KARAMAN by land, that are not among your Core Provinces.
effect: Gain a Claim token in 3 of RUM, KURDISTAN, CRIMEA, SYRIA, or PALESTINE.

name: Mediterranean Supremacy
goal: Own or Vassalize 2+ of Creta, Cyprus, Malta, Sardenya, or Baleares.
effect: Gain 1 Light Ship, and a Claim token in NAPLES or SICILY.

name: Control the Danube
goal: Own or Vassalize Beograd, Pest, and 2+ other original Hungarian Core Provinces.
effect: Gain 2 Military Power, and a Claim token in ROYAL HUNGARY.

name: Conquer Levant
goal: Occupy, Own, or Vassalize 4+ Provinces in SYRIA or PALESTINE.
effect: Gain 2 Military Power, and a Claim token in EGYPT and CYRENAICA.

name: Control Barbary Coast
goal: Own or Vassalize 6+ Provinces in TRIPOLITANIA, TUNISIA, or ALGIERS.
effect: Gain 2 Galleys, and a Claim token in any of the above Areas.

name: Control Black Sea
goal: Own or Vassalize 9+ Ports facing the BLACK SEA.
effect: Gain 2 Light Ships.

name: Conquer Mesopotamia
goal: Own or Vassalize Mosul, Kirkuk, Tikrit, Baghdad, and Basra.
effect: Gain 3 Military Power.

name: Conquer Egypt
goal: Own or Vassalize all Provinces in EGYPT and CYRENAICA.
effect: Gain a Claim token in 3 of Hejaz, Yemen, AEGEAN ARCHIPELAGO, TRIPOLITANIA, TUNISIA, or ALGIERS.

name: Recover from Varna
goal: Have 2+ Military Power, a Royal Marriage token, and a Ruler (not Interregnum) in play.
effect: Gain 1 Stability. You may pay 3 Diplomatic Power to immediately Research ?Tolerance?.

name: Defeat the Knights
goal: Own or Vassalize 3+ Provinces in PRUSSIA.
effect: Gain 2 Galleys in the BALTIC SEA and a Claim token in an Area adjacent to it, or pay 3 Military Power to immediately Research ?Noble Knights?.

name: Reincorporate Mazovia
goal: Own Warszawa, and have 3+ Large Towns.
effect: Draw an Administrative or Diplomatic Action Card, or gain a Claim token in LITHUANIA and RED RUTHENIA.

name: The Commonwealth
goal: Own or Vassalize all Provinces in LITHUANIA.
effect: Gain a Claim token or 2 Influence cubes in 2 of RED RUTHENIA, WHITE RUTHENIA, WESTERN UKRAINE, EASTERN UKRAINE, or MOLDAVIA.

name: The Polish Navy
goal: Own 2+ Ports and 4+ Light Ships.
effect: Gain a Claim token in an Area adjacent to a Sea Zone that has any of your Ports facing it.

name: Jagiellonian Dynasty
goal: Own or Vassalize 4+ Provinces in BOHEMIA, ROYAL HUNGARY, HUNGARIAN PLAIN, or TRANSYLVANIA.
effect: Gain a Claim token or 2 Influence cubes in any Area with Bohemian or Hungarian Core Provinces.

name: Break the Rus
goal: Own or Vassalize 8+ Provinces adjacent to MOSCOW & RYAZAN.
effect: Gain a third Merchant or 3 Trade Power.

name: Dominate the Baltic
goal: Own or Vassalize 4+ Provinces in ESTONIA & LIVONIA or POMORYE.
effect: You may pay 1 Administrative Power to Expand the L?beck Trade Node adjacent to the Baltic Sea.

name: Revenge for Varna
goal: Own or Vassalize all Provinces in WALLACHIA & BULGARIA.
effect: Gain 3 Military Power.

name: Black Sea Ports
goal: Own or Vassalize 4+ Ports facing the BLACK SEA.
effect: Gain 1 Light Ship or 2 Galleys in the BLACK SEA, and a Claim token in an Area adjacent to it.

name: House of Vasa
goal: Own or Vassalize 4+ Provinces in SVEALAND, G?TALAND & SK?NE, or FINLAND.
effect: Gain 2 Light Ships in the BALTIC SEA.

name: House of Wettin
goal: Own or Vassalize 3+ Provinces adjacent to SAXONY.
effect: Gain a total of 3 Influence cubes in any Areas within the HRE.
